DROP PROCEDURE [OM].[SP_TASK_END]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_TASK_END] @task_name [varchar](100),@pipeline_runid [VARCHAR](50),@data_layer [nvarchar](150),@status [VARCHAR](30) AS
BEGIN

	IF((SELECT COUNT(1)
FROM OM.OM_COPY_ACTIVITY_DTL OCAD
INNER JOIN OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
		 ON OTR.TASK_NAME = OCAD.TASK_NAME
		 AND OCAD.PROCESS_DATE = OTR.PROCESS_DATE
		 AND OCAD.CREATE_DATETIME BETWEEN OTR.START_DATETIME AND COALESCE(OTR.END_DATETIME,'9999-12-31')
		 AND OTR.PIPELINE_RUNID = @pipeline_runid 
		 AND OTR.TASK_RUN_ID = concat(@pipeline_runid,'-',UPPER(@task_name)) 
		 AND OTR.DATA_LAYER = @data_layer 
		 AND STATUS_ID = 2
WHERE OCAD.TASK_NAME = @task_name
	AND (
		COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSSKIPPED, 0) > 0
		OR COALESCE(OCAD.ROWSREJECTED, 0) > 0
		))>0)
		SELECT @status='FAILED'

	---END WORKFLOW
	UPDATE [OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] 
	SET 
		STATUS_ID = (SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = UPPER(@status)), 
		END_DATETIME = CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) 
	WHERE 
		PIPELINE_RUNID = @pipeline_runid AND
		TASK_RUN_ID = concat(@pipeline_runid,'-',UPPER(@task_name)) AND
		DATA_LAYER = @data_layer AND
		STATUS_ID = 2; 
END
GO
